visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Asian women, identified as a mother and daughter, stand smiling in a brightly lit retail environment with a PRADA sign visible in the background. The younger woman has long black hair and a white t-shirt, while the older woman has short brown hair and a white collared shirt. (2) Extreme close-up shots analyze the older woman's facial skin texture, specifically showing dry areas and fine lines around the eyes. A third woman with vibrant green hair and a white shirt with a black tie appears, using a white cotton pad to cleanse the older woman's face. (3) A hand holds a PRADA cushion foundation compact, featuring a black nylon lid and a triangular silver logo. The green-haired woman applies the product to the older woman's cheek using a puff, demonstrating the immediate smoothing effect. (4) A split-screen montage compares the older woman as a "Desert Skin" representative and the green-haired influencer as an "Oily Skin" representative. Close-up shots show the beige foundation inside the compact and the triangular shape of the puff being used on the nose area. (5) The scene shifts outdoors where the three women are laughing and posing for a selfie using a smartphone. The green-haired woman hands a small PRADA gift bag to the older woman, who looks delighted. (6) The video concludes with high-quality shots of a PRADA beauty counter display, showcasing rows of lipsticks and the cushion foundations under professional studio lighting. The influencer's face is shown again in a 7-hour wear-test update.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music with a steady drum beat and bright synthesizers starts immediately. A male narrator begins speaking in a very fast, high-arousal tone, introducing the mother and daughter. Vocal clarity is extremely high. (2) Frequent digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects trigger as variety-show style text appears on the screen. The female influencer's voice enters with a friendly, animated tone, describing the product's suitability for different skin types. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the visual cuts from a close-up of the older woman to the green-haired woman holding the compact. The background music maintains a consistent tempo throughout the discussion of the product's technical features. (4) An incidental camera shutter sound effect plays during the selfie sequence, followed by audible female laughter and light cheering, indicating a happy social interaction. The male narrator returns to describe the beauty counter's location. (5) The video concludes with the female influencer providing a detailed wear-test summary. Her speech rate is moderate and professional, perfectly overlaid on the energetic background track. The music ends with a clean fade-out.
